remarks: Picture-perfect 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath colonial ideally situated in one of East Norwalk's most desirable neighborhoods! With only a 5-7 minute walk to the train station and just a short stroll from scenic Calf Pasture Beach, this home blends timeless charm with modern updates for comfortable, coastal living. Step inside to discover hardwood floors throughout, a beautifully updated kitchen with modern finishes, and tastefully renovated bathrooms. The classic colonial layout with all 3 bedrooms and a full bath on the upper level offers a warm and inviting atmosphere, perfect for both everyday living and entertaining.  Families will love the fully fenced backyard-ideal for play or pets-as well as the wraparound deck, perfect for summer gatherings or family meals. The covered front porch also provides a cozy spot to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind in the evening.  Don't miss this rare opportunity to rent a turnkey home in a prime location near beaches, parks, dining, and train/I-95 access!
